{"notes":"- **Player**: A Description tab with clickable timestamps, YouTube's most replayed graph on the scrubber, section looping, and Ctrl+wheel zoom on a paused frame.
- **Shortcuts**: Every hotkey is listed in Settings > Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+/), and you can rebind any of them.
- **Appearance**: Video mode now uses the black theme with your accent color, Compact density slims the title bar and side rail, and both can tuck away while a video plays.
- **Library**: Tag videos from the right-click menu and open a page for each tag. Finished downloads fly into their card.
- **Mini player**: Ghost mode keeps the mini player on top at low opacity and lets every click pass through (Ctrl+Alt+G).
- **Notifications**: Filter the island by uploads or downloads, and mute any kind you don't want.
- **Downloads**: Zen browser sign-in, size estimates that count the video stream, and a rate-limited caption no longer fails the whole video.
- **And more**: Up next sorting, end cards with creator avatars, auto captions in full phrases, faster switching between Library and Music, Settings inside Music, a private activity log that never leaves your PC, and fixes for lyrics, the island and the music player bar.","additions":["Player: Description tab next to Comments, with clickable timestamps and chapters built from the description","Player: YouTube's most replayed graph above the scrubber","Player: loop a section of a video with the brackets button","Player: Ctrl+wheel zooms into a paused frame up to 8x","Player: Next up panel with a now-playing card, watch progress and a sort menu","Player: end cards with the creator's avatar and a Hide button","Settings: Keyboard shortcuts tab (Ctrl+/) where every hotkey can be rebound","Appearance: black theme with your accent in video mode, Legacy colors brings back the brown","Appearance: App density (Cozy or Compact) slims the title bar and side rail, and both can hide while a video plays","Library: tag videos by hand, with tag chips and a page per tag","Library: finished downloads fly into their card in the Video Library","Mini player: ghost mode (Ctrl+Alt+G) with a chapter readout","Notifications: filter the island by uploads or downloads and mute each kind","Downloads: Zen browser as a sign-in cookie source","Music: Settings opens inside Music, and Add from screenshots on a playlist","Activity: a private local activity log for future stats; nothing is uploaded"],"fixes":["Downloads: closing the downloader right after clicking Download no longer drops the download","Downloads: a rate-limited caption no longer fails the whole video, and errors show yt-dlp's real message","Downloads: video size estimates count the video stream instead of only the audio","Downloads: Edge, Brave and Safari leave the cookie list because yt-dlp cannot read them on Windows","Player: auto captions show the original transcript in complete phrases","Player: downloads saved without chapters or the replay graph fetch them once when opened","Music: one click plays a song in a playlist","Music: synced lyrics load for label uploads, and the lyrics header no longer covers the lines","Music: profile and stats show a loading state instead of empty zeros","Music: the player bar drops a track whose file was deleted","Dynamic Island: no longer freezes at the end of a song on repeat or after seeking back","App: switching between Library and Music keeps each mode's scroll and open page"]}
